headline: A 1999 order changed the existing rules that protect US ships, harbors, ports, and waterfront facilities.
what_it_does: This executive order amends Executive Order 10173, an older order that sets rules for safeguarding vessels, harbors, ports, and waterfront facilities in the United States. The title does not say what specific changes were made. No summary was provided, so the details of the changes are unclear.

who_it_affects.group: Ship owners and operators in US waters
who_it_affects.how: They may be subject to changed safety and security rules for vessels.
They may face updated rules on how harbors, ports, and waterfront facilities are protected.
